items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 along with Tank Bigsby and DeVonta Smith; ETR final Sunday board lists him OUT. Will Shipley expected to lead Philly backfield usage.
items.why: Final injury report / ETR board; hamstring, DNP practice
items.implication: Philly RB committee (Shipley primary) vs JAX in London; WR targets shift without Smith
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries/routes for backups and remaining WRs/TE

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially OUT for Sunday night vs Falcons; Ravens also ruled out others. Tyler Huntley to start.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Flowers/Likely/Henry impacted by QB change
items.opportunity: Check Huntley pass volume and RB usage

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will start vs Giants; WR Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring).
items.implication: Daniels return boosts offense; Diggs absence opens targets for McLaurin (Q) and others
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WAS WRs/TE

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs Browns.
items.implication: Braelon Allen full workload again; Wilson target share up without Mitchell
items.opportunity: Allen lead back carries/routes; Wilson volume boost

items.text: Quentin Johnston listed OUT on ETR Sunday board; Schefter confirms Chargers ruled him out along with OL/S.
items.implication: Ladd McConkey (also Q) and others absorb WR targets
items.opportunity: Target/route share increase for remaining LAC WRs

items.text: Chris Olave and Dallas Goedert listed IN on ETR final board (cleared); Goedert return notable amid Eagles injuries.
items.implication: Olave full role in NO; Goedert TE targets available with Smith/Barkley out

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (IN); Levitan projects much better role/workload this week despite ankle maintenance and prior Week 4 drag, currently 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier.
items.why: Cleared final report; fan/media pressure on prior usage; gut better role but downside risk remains
items.implication: Workload upgrade vs prior week; startable with elevated projection
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry share expected over Allgeier

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift has no injury designation (hip/knee) for Sunday at GB; Kyle Monangai ruled out.
items.implication: Swift clear lead back role with Monangai out

items.text: Berry LOVES Nico Collins vs Titans; ranks him WR8. Volume/red-zone hog in excellent matchup (Cowboys D inflates WR scoring).
items.why: Target volume including RZ + soft Titans matchup/DvP
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high upside week

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname for target/fantasy point gobbling. Soft run D + potential Bengals WR injuries boost.
items.why: Workload + matchup; Chase/Higgins Q could funnel more

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans off injury report with no designation for Sunday at Seattle; Bosa and Juszczyk OUT.
items.implication: Evans full go; SF offense otherwise dinged on DL/FB

items.text: Levitan flags multi-risk downside for Malik Nabers later this season: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential QB change to McCarthy, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) style; plus recent target frustration.
items.why: Sore knee (missed practice), shoulder history, QB/coaching uncertainty, expressed frustration
items.implication: Longer-term caution despite talent; monitor week-to-week

items.text: Berry HATES Jalen Hurts (QB15) vs JAX London (rough stretch/banged line); Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle); Mark Andrews (TE17).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin/inefficient roles, usage concerns, Addison injury

items.text: Berry also loves Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH) on volume/matchup/coverage weaknesses.
